name: bge-m3-legal-v4
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3 for Greek legal/statute/daily retrieval (~147k query-passage pairs, MNRL, hard negatives, 2 epochs). Same 568M parameters and 1024 dims as the base. Recorded because the card prints a 'stock bge-m3' column and a v4 column in one held-out recall@1 table. Scope is Greek: it regresses on English (97.0 -> 96.0) and cross-lingual EN->EL (90.8 -> 82.1), both printed in the same table. Licence mit.

benchmarks.name: Greek legal recall@1 (n=1200)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| register | stock bge-m3 | v4 |', row 'Greek legal (n=1200)': 57.8 base vs 92.2. Held-out, rank-the-true-passage, 1024-dim mean-pooled. 147k query-passage pairs, GreekBarBench fully held out.
